description:
Find answers in your team's Tango how-to guides. Search for a process, browse your team library, and read step-by-step instructions with links to the original guides. View a recorded screenshot when you need a closer look at a step.

Connect your Tango account and choose a workspace. Tango retrieves guides you have permission to access in that workspace. This plugin helps explain documented processes; it cannot create or edit guides or perform tasks in your browser.

defaultPrompt: How do I submit an expense?
How do I onboard a new teammate?
